MAKE EVERY NOTE COUNT

Edit note

Chord pitch changes transpose the entire voicing. Pitch and length apply to melodic instruments. Drum repeats work on every track.

WELCOME TO POCKET

Your first beat, in a minute.

  1. Describe a feeling. Pick a palette and generate. Words like “space”, “R&B”, “jazzy”, and “140 bpm” steer the musical rules.
  2. Make it yours. Switch sections and bars, tap steps, adjust track volumes, or mute instruments. Keys and bass use generated pitches.
  3. Catch a rhythm. Record taps or beatbox at the selected BPM. Detection aligns the first hit to beat one. Apply it to replace the selected pattern’s kick, snare, and hats. Classification is approximate; edit any wrong hits.
  4. Build a song. Arrange intro, verse, hook, and outro. Enable Song mode to hear it, then export a mix or individual stem.

Refine a beat: Lock any instrument with its L button, then vary the unlocked layers. Enable Edit notes to change pitch, velocity, length, rolls, or 808 slides. Copy/paste applies to the current bar across all tracks. New beat replaces all layers; variation respects locks. MIDI exports the notes, timing, tempo and velocities, but not synthesized sounds, effects, or 808 pitch slides.

Projects autosave in this browser. Download a project to move it between devices. Microphone access requires HTTPS or localhost and your permission. Keep the browser foreground while playing or recording.

Space = play / pause. A–K = drum and instrument pads. This is a procedural composer, not a trained text-to-music AI.
